info.name: Almost Lover
info.plot: Late-night radio host He Xiaoran has spent years suppressing her past heartbreak after secretly loving her close friend, Xiao Shangqi, who pursued a relationship with their mutual friend, Chen Fei'er. To preserve their friendship, she kept her feelings hidden. However, eight years later, Xiao Shangqi returns after years abroad, bringing back memories she thought she had left behind.

seasons.name: Stagione 1
seasons.plot: He Xiao Ran is the MC of a late-night radio show. But events that tainted the last few years of her life as a student still haunt her. She secretly loved Xiao Shang Qi , a close male friend. But instead of ending up with him, she had to watch on helplessly as he pursued his dreams of love with another woman – their mutual friend Chen Fei Er. She was forced to endure the heartbreak of watching the man she loved begin a relationship with her close friend. And for the sake of the friendships she valued, she kept her feelings under lock and key.

translations.title: 谁都知道我爱你
translations.overview: 何笑然与萧尚麒、陈菲儿是学生时期形影不离的好朋友。何笑然暗恋了萧尚麒八年，也见证了他对陈菲儿的追求，为了友情，她选择将秘密留在心里，却一而再地看到陈菲儿随意对待萧尚麒对她的喜欢。大学毕业前夕的一桩桩事件，让三个人的友情分崩离析。在遭遇爱情与友情的双重背叛后，曾经的“小太阳”何笑然从上海逃到周边城市，成为了一个深夜电台节目的主播。时隔三年，萧尚麒扛着巨大压力来到这座城市经营一家濒临倒闭的四星级酒店，两人带着对彼此的误会和不解在异地他乡重逢，在彼此伤害又相互关心维护的过程中相知相爱。
